treatments.name: Ultrasonic Teeth Cleaning & Polishing
treatments.short_description: Removes stubborn tartar, yellow plaque, smoke stains, and tea/coffee pigmentation using gentle ultrasonic vibrations without harming enamel.
treatments.is_painful: Completely painless. Most patients describe a mild tickling sensation.
treatments.recovery_time: Immediate. You can eat and drink 30 minutes after fluoride application.
treatments.recommended_frequency: Every 6 months for healthy gums and fresh breath.

treatments.name: Single-Sitting Pain-Free Root Canal Treatment (RCT)
treatments.short_description: Saves infected or severely decayed teeth. Performed under advanced micro-endodontic rotary systems with computerized painless local anesthesia.
treatments.is_painful: 100% pain-free during the procedure thanks to targeted modern anesthetics. Eliminates existing toothache permanently.
treatments.recovery_time: Mild tenderness for 24 hours managed with mild pain relievers. Crown placement recommended 3-5 days later.
treatments.warranty: Crowns come with 5 to 15 years replacement warranty.

treatments.name: Digital HD RVG X-Rays & Panoramic OPG Scan
treatments.short_description: Ultra-low radiation digital dental imaging providing instant HD views of tooth roots, hidden cavities, bone density, and impacted wisdom teeth.
treatments.recovery_time: Instant results viewed live on chairside HD monitors.
treatments.safety: 90% less radiation than conventional film X-rays.

treatments.name: Painless Tooth & Impacted Wisdom Tooth Extraction
treatments.short_description: Gentle surgical removal of decayed, damaged, or impacted wisdom teeth that cause swelling, cheek biting, or jaw pain.
treatments.is_painful: Virtually painless with deep local anesthesia. Sedation options available for nervous patients.
treatments.recovery_time: 2-3 days for initial healing; soft diet for 48 hours.
treatments.post_op_kit: Free post-op ice pack, medicated gauze, and prescription supplied.

treatments.name: Cosmetic Smile Makeover & Teeth Whitening
treatments.short_description: In-clinic laser teeth whitening (up to 8 shades lighter in 45 mins), porcelain veneers, and composite bonding for gaps or chipped teeth.
treatments.is_painful: Painless with optional desensitizing gel application.
treatments.recovery_time: Immediate radiant smile. Avoid dark curries, red wine, and coffee for 48 hours.
treatments.longevity: Results typically last 1 to 3 years with good oral hygiene.

treatments.name: Swiss & German Titanium Dental Implants
treatments.short_description: The gold standard permanent replacement for missing teeth. Integrates directly into jawbone with natural look, bite power, and lifetime durability.
treatments.is_painful: Easier and less painful than a tooth extraction; done under gentle local anesthesia.
treatments.recovery_time: Minor swelling for 2-3 days. Full osseointegration over 8-12 weeks.
treatments.warranty: Lifetime warranty on titanium implant fixture.

treatments.name: Invisible Clear Aligners (Wire-Free Orthodontics)
treatments.short_description: Transparent, removable plastic trays that straighten crooked teeth without ugly metal wires or dietary restrictions.
treatments.is_painful: Gentle pressure when switching to a new tray every 10-14 days.

treatments.name: Pediatric Dentistry (Kids Milk Teeth Care)
treatments.short_description: Friendly, fear-free treatments for children including cavity fillings, fluoride varnish, space maintainers, and habit-breaking appliances.
treatments.is_painful: Fun, playful atmosphere with child-friendly gentle touch.

objection_answers.pain: At Dr. XYZ Dental Care, we specialize in painless dentistry. We use computer-controlled numbing gel, ultra-fine needles, and modern rotary tools so you won't feel anything during treatments like Root Canal or Implants.
objection_answers.price: We offer complete transparency with no hidden charges. Our promotional ad rates (such as ₹499 Cleaning or ₹3,500 RCT) are locked upon booking. We also offer 0% interest EMI options for treatments over ₹15,000.
objection_answers.deposit: The ₹500 booking deposit guarantees your dedicated doctor time slot, eliminates waiting, and is 100% adjusted toward your clinic bill upon arrival. It is also fully refundable if cancelled 4 hours prior.
objection_answers.experience: Dr. XYZ has over 15 years of clinical expertise, holds an MDS in Prosthodontics & Implantology, and has successfully treated over 12,000 satisfied patients in Bandra West.
objection_answers.safety: Our clinic follows strict 6-tier sterilization protocols compliant with international OSHA and CDC medical guidelines, using class-B autoclaves and 100% disposable patient kits.
